hero.title: Who is Eder Balbino
hero.subtitle: Courage to face the new. I'm third.

origins_purpose.title: Origins and Purpose
origins_purpose.intro_short: Discover my humble beginnings and the journey that shaped my purpose.

humble_beginnings.title: Humble Beginnings
humble_beginnings.summary: Born in Belo Horizonte, I learned faith, integrity, and generosity from my parents.
humble_beginnings.content: I was born in a simple home in Belo Horizonte (MG), the fifth child of Pedro Balbino and Maria José — a couple who taught me the value of faith, integrity, and generosity. My father was a pastor and founder of a Baptist church, and I grew up surrounded by music, friendship, and spirituality. I was a drummer in my youth and had a passion for rock'n roll.

early_dreams.title: Early Entrepreneurial Dreams
early_dreams.summary: My childhood dream of entrepreneurship and early lessons in investment and generosity.
early_dreams.content: Since I was 7 years old, I dreamed of entrepreneurship. I saved coins to one day have my own company — although I spent it all on popsicles from Dona Teófila when friends came to visit. It was the first of many lessons about investment and generosity.

family.title: Family
family.intro_short: Meet the most important people in my life: my wife, children, parents, and siblings.

close_family.title: Family
close_family.summary: Meet my wife Heloísa Cristina and our four amazing children.
close_family.content: I am married to the wonderful Heloísa Cristina and father of four incredible children: Emily (13), Sofia (10), Ravi (7), and Nicole (3).

extended_family.title: Extended Family
extended_family.summary: Learn about my parents and siblings.
extended_family.content: I am the youngest among my siblings Quesia, Dan, Júnia, and Sara, with whom I maintain a relationship of love and friendship.

faith_resilience.title: Faith and Resilience
faith_resilience.intro_short: My journey of faith, pastoral mission, and how resilience helped me overcome challenges.

mission.title: Mission
mission.content: I am a man of reformed faith and a missions pastor at Igreja Missão VIDE (Integral Vision of the Gospel), where I lead teams that support 20 missionary families in countries such as Mozambique, Angola, Tunisia, Spain, France, and Brazil.

chaos.title: The Chaos
chaos.content_p1: I believe in God's sovereignty and transformation through suffering. In 2023, I faced one of the greatest trials of my life when I was targeted by a Federal Police operation authorized by Minister Alexandre de Moraes. I was investigated for a political plot involving then-president Jair Bolsonaro, after my system identified flaws in electronic voting machines.
chaos.content_p2: After 10 months of investigation, the Federal Police concluded that I had told the truth and done everything correctly. The case gained national and international repercussion, and I was called 'The Genius of Uberlândia'. Subsequently, I was summoned as a witness for both the defense and prosecution in the process conducted by the Brazilian Attorney General's Office.
chaos.content_p3: This experience solidified my conviction that God is sovereign even in the valleys.

education_learning.title: Education and Learning
education_learning.intro_short: My academic and theological journey, and the personal challenge that led me to master English.

academic.title: Academic Background
academic.content: I hold a degree in Statistics and a postgraduate degree in Strategic Information Management from UFMG, one of Brazil's three most renowned universities.

theology.title: Teology
theology.content: I also have a degree in Theology from the Society of Interdisciplinary Biblical Studies (SEBI) in Brasília.

english.title: The English Challenge
english.content: My English was born from a personal challenge: I studied 12 hours a day for three months and completed the entire English Live (formerly English Town) course. The effort paid off: I ranked 1st worldwide, with double the points of the second-place finisher.

pastoral_mission.title: Pastoral Life and Mission
pastoral_mission.intro_short: My role as a pastor, writer, mentor, and involvement in social projects in Africa.

pastor.title: Pastor, Writer, and Mentor
pastor.content: As a pastor, writer, and mentor, I seek to inspire people to fully trust in God.

book.title: Book 'Give Up Control'
book.content: I am the author of the book 'Desista do Controle' (Give Up Control), a work about surrender and total dependence on the Lord.

social_projects.title: Social Projects
social_projects.content: I am also an investor in social projects in Africa, especially in Mozambique, through Missão NASCE, which receives 20% of Gaio's profits to support families and children in vulnerable situations.

career_entrepreneurship.title: Career and Entrepreneurship
career_entrepreneurship.intro_short: My entrepreneurial journey of over 25 years and my current roles in technology companies.

companies.title: Founded Companies
companies.content: I have been an entrepreneur for over 25 years, having founded companies such as Loja Rentável, i-Varejo, Lince (sold to Grupo Algar in 2014), AioNow, Beelong, and Gaio DataOS.

current_roles.title: Current Roles
current_roles.content: At Beelong, I am Chief Strategy Officer. At Gaio, I am founder and CEO. Gaio develops Gaio DataOS, a complete data operating system with AI and Machine Learning.

recognitions_achievements.title: Recognitions and Achievements
recognitions_achievements.intro_short: Highlights and awards that marked my professional and entrepreneurial journey.
achievements: Winner of the VISA Acceleration Program with an immersion in Silicon Valley
GPTW (Great Place to Work) seal with a maximum score

professional_experience.title: Professional Experience
professional_experience.intro_short: My involvement in data intelligence projects and as a professor at renowned institutions.

consulting.title: Consulting and Projects
consulting.content: I have worked on data intelligence projects in institutions such as TCU, TCE-CE, State Treasury Departments, Ministry of Planning, BNB, Embraer, Oi, Algar Telecom, and Martins Atacadista.

teaching.title: Teaching
teaching.content: I was also a postgraduate professor in Data Science at PUC Minas and a professor at YWAM (Jocum).

speaker_mentor.title: Speaker and Mentor
speaker_mentor.intro_short: My experience as a speaker at international events and mentor for entrepreneurs and young professionals.
speaker_mentor.content: A speaker at international Gartner and Informa events, I share insights on faith, technology, and purpose. I mentor entrepreneurs and young professionals.

leadership_values.title: Leadership and Values
leadership_values.intro_short: My leadership philosophy, based on example, love, and excellence.
leadership_values.content: I lead by example. I believe that loving is not always pleasing—it is helping people become better. I do everything with excellence, as if for God.

international_experience.title: International Experience
international_experience.intro_short: My experiences and learning in various countries and cities around the world.
international_experience.content: I have worked and learned in various countries and cities worldwide, including the USA (Silicon Valley, Miami, NY), Europe (Paris, London, Milan), Latin America, and the Middle East (Dubai).

technical_skills.title: Technical Skills
technical_skills.intro_short: My main skills and tools in data intelligence, AI, and development.
technical_skills.skills: Gaio DataOS, SAS, RapidMiner, KNIME, IBM Analytics, Watson, Tableau, QlikView, Python, SQL, Oracle, MySQL, SQL Server, Teradata, MemSQL, Docker, Linux, Windows, macOS, CRM Tools, MS Office, PHP

relational_characteristics.title: Relational Characteristics
relational_characteristics.intro_short: The traits that define my way of interacting and building relationships.
relational_characteristics.characteristics: Innovative, Generous, Self-control, Pleasure in teaching, Patience, Intensity, Love

personal_philosophy.title: Personal Philosophy
personal_philosophy.intro_short: My core belief about inner peace, conviction, and unwavering faith.
personal_philosophy.quote: “There is inner peace even amidst outer war.”
personal_philosophy.explanation: I live with serenity in chaos, conviction in uncertainty, and unwavering faith in God's purpose.
